html.name: index.html
html.code:
Questions, answered

Can’t find yours? Ask us. A person replies within a day.

Is it really free?

Yes, for groups of up to five people. Bigger groups pay $3 a month per group, not per person.

Do my friends need an account?

No. Share a link and they can view and add expenses as a guest.

Can I export my data?

Any time, as CSV or PDF. If you leave, your data leaves with you.

Which currencies do you support?

All 160 ISO currencies, converted at the daily reference rate.
